 await t.test('COST/MAP lifecycle has no tariff, no financial posting, exact private backup/rollback/reinstall',async()=>{for(const suffix of ['precheck','backup',''])await q(await read('../supabase/folha_horas_mapas_custos'+(suffix?'_'+suffix:'')+'.sql'));await q(await read('../supabase/folha_horas_mapas_custos_postcheck.sql'));await q(await read('../supabase/folha_horas_mapas_custos_rollback.sql'));await q(await read('../supabase/folha_horas_mapas_custos.sql'));await q(await read('../supabase/folha_horas_mapas_custos_postcheck.sql'));});
 const mapCall=(actor,work=100,month=today.slice(0,7)+'-01')=>as(a,actor,'SELECT fn_folha_mapa_horas_v3($1::uuid,$2::date) v',[id(work),month]);
 const rateBody=(person,revision,cost,from=today)=>({version:3,request_id:id(seq++),person_id:id(person),effective_from:from,expected_revision:revision,hourly_cost:cost,evidence:{document:'Custo/hora sintético aprovado RH',reference:'RH-test'},reason:'Vigência documental sintética confirmada'});
 const rateCall=(actor,body,confirm=false,token=null,conn=a)=>as(conn,actor,'SELECT fn_folha_custo_hora_aprovar_v3($1::jsonb,$2::boolean,$3::text) v',[body,confirm,token]);
 await t.test('COST/MAP without proven tariff is pending/null, never worker valor_hora inferred',async()=>{const m=await mapCall(10);const ordinary=m.groups.find(x=>x.person_id===id(773));assert.equal(ordinary.valuation_status,'custo_hora_rh_pendente');assert.equal(ordinary.provisional_estimate,null);assert.equal(m.provisional_estimate,null);assert.equal(m.known_provisional_estimate,null);assert.equal(m.financial_effect,false);assert.equal(m.legacy_costs_included,false);});
 await t.test('COST/MAP only RH admin approves with explicit evidence/date; concurrent one version/history',async()=>{const body=rateBody(773,0,18.5);for(const actor of [11,13,14,15,17])await assert.rejects(rateCall(actor,body),e=>e.code==='42501');await assert.rejects(rateCall(10,{...body,evidence:{}}),/RH_COST_PROOF_REQUIRED/);const p=await rateCall(10,body),out=await Promise.all([rateCall(10,body,true,p.versao,a),rateCall(10,body,true,p.versao,b)]);assert.deepEqual(out[0],out[1]);assert.equal((await q('SELECT count(*)::integer n FROM folha_custos_hora_versoes WHERE colaborador_id=$1',[id(773)])).rows[0].n,1);assert.equal((await q('SELECT count(*)::integer n FROM folha_custos_hora_historico')).rows[0].n,1);await assert.rejects(rateCall(10,{...body,hourly_cost:20},true,p.versao),/IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT/);const m=await mapCall(10),g=m.groups.find(x=>x.person_id===id(773));assert.equal(g.minutes,480);assert.equal(g.provisional_estimate,148);assert.equal(g.valuation_blocks_rh,false);const foreman=await mapCall(13);assert.equal(foreman.groups.find(x=>x.person_id===id(773)).provisional_estimate,null);});
 await t.test('COST/MAP HR31 9h across works remain factual, whole worker/day pending despite approved tariff, no HE cost',async()=>{await faltouWorker(776);await dstSave(13,await dstBody(776,100,[custom('08:00','13:00')]));await dstSave(781,await dstBody(776,102,[custom('14:00','18:00')]));const body=rateBody(776,0,20),p=await rateCall(10,body);await rateCall(10,body,true,p.versao);for(const work of [100,102]){const m=await mapCall(10,work),g=m.groups.find(x=>x.person_id===id(776));assert.equal(g.valuation_status,'pendente_de_valorizacao');assert.equal(g.provisional_estimate,null);assert.equal(g.valuation_blocks_rh,false);assert.equal(m.he_cost_calculated,false);}const ev=(await q('SELECT * FROM folha_avaliacoes_diarias WHERE colaborador_id=$1 AND data=$2',[id(776),today])).rows[0];assert.equal(ev.realizado_minutes,540);assert.equal(ev.excedente_minutes,60);await adminOp('daily_he_validate',{person_id:id(776),date:today,expected_revision:ev.revision,reason:'HE informativa reconhecida RH'});const c=await monthContext(10,776,today.slice(0,7)+'-01');assert.equal(c.snapshot.pending.some(x=>x.reason==='pendente_de_valorizacao'),false);assert.equal((await q('SELECT count(*)::integer n FROM folha_he h JOIN folha_registos f ON f.id=h.folha_id WHERE f.colaborador_id=$1',[id(776)])).rows[0].n,0);});
 await t.test('COST/MAP approved month is consolidated once; externals hours only; existing material/labour ledger untouched',async()=>{const prior=(await q('SELECT to_jsonb(l) value FROM lancamentos_mao_obra l ORDER BY id')).rows;const past=(await q("SELECT (date_trunc('month',$1::date)-interval '1 month')::date::text d",[today])).rows[0].d,m=await mapCall(10,100,past);const person=m.groups.filter(x=>x.person_id===id(740));assert.ok(person.length);assert.ok(person.every(x=>x.consolidated));assert.equal(m.provisional_minutes,0);assert.ok((await mapCall(10)).groups.filter(x=>x.kind==='external').every(x=>x.provisional_estimate===null&&x.valuation_status==='horas_apenas'));assert.deepEqual((await q('SELECT to_jsonb(l) value FROM lancamentos_mao_obra l ORDER BY id')).rows,prior);});
 await t.test('COST/MAP version range preserves old approved price, no direct/GUC write',async()=>{const tomorrow=(await q('SELECT ($1::date+1)::text d',[today])).rows[0].d,body=rateBody(773,1,19,tomorrow),p=await rateCall(10,body);await rateCall(10,body,true,p.versao);const versions=(await q('SELECT revision,custo_hora::text,vigente_desde,vigente_ate FROM folha_custos_hora_versoes WHERE colaborador_id=$1 ORDER BY revision',[id(773)])).rows;assert.equal(versions[0].custo_hora,'18.5000');assert.equal(versions[0].vigente_ate,tomorrow);assert.equal(versions[1].revision,2);assert.equal((await mapCall(10)).groups.find(x=>x.person_id===id(773)).provisional_estimate,148);await a.query('BEGIN');try{await a.query('SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated');await a.query("SELECT set_config('folha.rh_cost_rpc','on',true)");await assert.rejects(a.query('UPDATE folha_custos_hora_versoes SET custo_hora=0'),e=>e.code==='42501');}finally{await a.query('ROLLBACK');}});

 await t.test('COST RH reader supplies latest revision including future version; scope and role remain controlled',async()=>{const c=await as(a,10,'SELECT fn_folha_custo_hora_contexto_v3($1::uuid) v',[id(773)]);assert.equal(c.expected_revision,2);assert.equal(c.versions.length,2);assert.equal(c.history.length,2);assert.equal(c.can_approve,true);const r=await as(a,11,'SELECT fn_folha_custo_hora_contexto_v3($1::uuid) v',[id(773)]);assert.equal(r.can_approve,false);await assert.rejects(as(a,13,'SELECT fn_folha_custo_hora_contexto_v3($1::uuid) v',[id(773)]),e=>e.code==='42501');await assert.rejects(as(a,10,'SELECT fn_folha_custo_hora_contexto_v3($1::uuid) v',[id(49)]),e=>e.code==='42501');});
